what: The Hero section is pinned under the header and follows the scroll for 2000px (scrub 1.5). While the big title, copy and button rise 30px and fade out at .1 intervals, the photo frame below expands in place to fill the screen (100vw×100vh) and climbs flush to the section’s top edge. After a beat it shrinks to .95x and vanishes. No spacer is added while pinned (only a 1200px empty distance), so the next section slides up over it.

options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Widening photo cell — the parent must be at the screen center so margin-left calc(50% - 50vw) sticks it to the screen’s left edge
options.[data-fx-part=fade]: Text blocks that slide up and fade out (multiple, optional)
options.header: Header selector — pins below it at that height (default none) = Screen top edge)
options.offset: px added to the fixed position, default 0
options.spacer: Empty distance behind the section (px), default 1200 — the rear section starts rising after the front one has dropped this much
options.stagger: Gap between text chunks (progress unit), default .1
options.hold: Pause length once fully widened (progress units, widening = 1), default 1 — if 0 it shrinks right away and disappears
options.to·to-h: Width and height of the expanded end, default 100vw·100vh
